name: Should I add a half-bath or a full bathroom?

mainEntity.name: Should I add a half-bath or a full bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding between a powder room and a full bathroom depends on your household goals and physical layout. A half-bath provides a convenient toilet and sink for guests on the main floor without sacrificing significant living space or budget. A full bathroom adds a shower or tub, which solves daily morning bottlenecks for growing families and provides private facilities for guest bedrooms or in-law suites. If resale value and family utility are the focus, adding a full or three-quarter bath yields greater functional capacity, provided you have the square footage to accommodate the shower footprint.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a half-bath to give guests convenient main-floor access in small spaces; choose a full bathroom if you need extra shower capacity for family members or overnight guests.
